info.title: Kasway v2 API
info.summary: Merchant commerce API with built-in KPR-1 covenant payments, checkout, and payment operations.
info.description: Kasway helps merchants and commerce platforms accept non-custodial KPR-1 covenant payments while keeping the operational records needed to run a business. The API covers merchant onboarding, API keys, invoices, checkout KPR-1 payment intent handoff, covenant settlement verification, settlement credits, webhooks, metrics, reconciliation exports, teams, inventory, media uploads, currencies, and Kaspa price data. Payment API versioning is negotiated through the optional `X-Kasway-API-Version` request header on checkout, commerce, and payment operations endpoints. Unsupported versions fail fast, and deprecated versions return `Deprecation` and optional `Sunset` headers on success.
